findings.note: Canucks' Nov 13 preview: Dylan Garand (6-7-1, .905) is the Rangers' main goalie with Shesterkin injured. NYR are 0-7-1 when allowing the first goal and have been outscored 15-5 in road third periods. Vancouver just claimed D Cameron Crotty.

ESPN's Nov 13 preview lists NYR at -225. It says Vancouver has three wins and six straight losses, and NYR beat them 6-2 on Oct 11. This is the last game of a West Coast trip on which the Rangers are 2-1.

Covers had no expert or computer picks for this game. Three Covers users picked NYR at -218, which is opinion only. Covers' trends list NYR 4-0 in the last four meetings in Vancouver, and Vancouver at 3-16-1.
